title: WWYK250063 - INSTALL REACT VII FACILITY, B9001, POST V19
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8137  AFSC PZIOC
detail_text: WWYK250063 - INSTALL REACT VII FACILITY, B9001, POST V19 The work to be performed under the terms of this contract consists of furnishing all materials, labor, plant, tools, transportation, equipment, testing services, quality control and incidentals required to accomplish the install of the React VII Facility at Tinker Air Force Base (AFB), Oklahoma. (Period of Performance 240 Calender Days from NTP) IAW FAR 36.204(f) THE ESTIMATED MAGNITUDE OF THIS PROJECT IS BETWEEN: $1,000,000 and $5,000,000
